name: spoiler-text
title: Spoiler Text
description: A phrase in a sentence hides under a shimmering field of specks, then a wave blows them away and the words come into focus.
useWhen: A sentence has one phrase that should be teased, then revealed: a twist, a price, a punchline.
A chat-style or social video needs the 'tap to reveal spoiler' moment.
avoidWhen: The whole text should appear with a plain reveal: use blur-in or mask-reveal-up.
The hidden part is long: the patch dominates the frame.
author: Kokonut UI

variables.label: Text before
variables.description: Visible text before the hidden phrase.

variables.description: The phrase hidden under the specks until the reveal.
variables.default: the lighthouse keeper had been writing the letters all along

variables.label: Text after
variables.description: Visible text after the hidden phrase.

variables.description: Same seed scatters the same specks every time.
